Donations are tax deductible and we need your support to continue our work into 2024. Or to text-to-donate, text LIBERTY to 53555Show more This week on VSRF LIVE Steve sits down with virologist and immunologist, Dr. Jennifer Smith, a former public health official in the Hawaii Department of Health and co-author of the new book, Pandemic in Paradise: An Insider’s View of COVID Corruption in Hawai’i. In her unique position during the pandemic as an epidemiological specialist in the Hawai’i Disease Outbreak Control Division, she played a key role in conducting disease investigations and overseeing other COVID-19 pandemic response efforts by identifying and investigating cases and contact tracing. In addition to her unique insights into how public health agencies handled (or mishandled) the pandemic response, she is also an expert in another emerging area of concern: Avian Influenza. During her tenure at Hawaii Department of Health she also held the role of surveillance coordinator, analyzing data and preparing the weekly influenza surveillance report.
Also joining us tonight are the three authors of the book, The Covid-19 Vaccines...What the Medical Industrial Complex is NOT Telling Us, retired attorney Sally Saxon, JD, Dr. James Thorp, and Dr. Deborah Viglione.
Please join us for this fascinating discussion and as always, share and bring some friends!
